title: 13 Best Herbal Creams For Runny Nose
intro: Herbal creams for Runny nose are topical preparations made from plant extracts that help soothe and calm the nasal passages, reducing excessive mucus secretion and congestion. Other effective herbal creams for runny nose include Ginger cream, which has natural anti-inflammatory properties to reduce nasal irritation, and Eucalyptus cream, which helps to break down mucus and promote drainage.
